messages:
alex.k: FYI we got a SIG questionnaire from HealthTech; they specifically asked for demonstrable access control evidence (SSO/SAML, MFA enforcement, RBAC mappings, service account controls). Need to bundle artifacts for their vendor risk team by EOD Fri.

sara.sales: thanks. can we list exactly what they want so i can sync with their sec lead? any must-haves vs nice-to-haves? :calendar:

alex.k: Must-haves per questionnaire: SAML metadata (SP metadata + IdP metadata), MFA policy screenshots + enforcement logs, example role matrix and least-privilege justification, service account creation/rotation process, scoped API keys and session length defaults. Nice-to-haves: SCIM provisioning flow, demo tenant with test users, sample terraform snippets for role provisioning.

jonah.sec: I can produce the following artifacts this week: 1) SAML SP metadata + signed cert thumbprint 2) Okta & AzureAD MFA enforcement policy screenshots and example policy IDs 3) RBAC matrix CSV (role -> perms) + short narrative about least privilege decisions 4) service-account rotation playbook (cli commands + rotation schedule)

jonah.sec: quick note: for MFA enforcement we enforce MFA at IdP for all interactive user sessions and require device MFA for privileged roles. We also log MFA events to our audit stream (see sample entries below).

jonah.sec: ```
2024-11-01T14:22:03Z alex.k LOGIN_SUCCESS user=alice method=okta_mfa device_approval=true
2024-11-01T14:24:10Z token_issue svc_account=redwood-poc role=ingest write=false
```

emily.ps: for the POC handoff, i'd like to include a single zip with: saml-metadata.xml, idp-cert-info.txt, mfa-policy.pdf, rbac-matrix.csv, svc-account-playbook.md, terraform-examples.tf. i'll take point to package and redact any customer-specific sids. timeline: jonah can drop artifacts by Thu morning, i package Thu afternoon, sara sends to prospect Thu EOD. sound ok?

sara.sales: perfect. i'll ask them if they need attestation/letter from our security team or just the artifacts. also ask if they require POC tenant access or a static artifact bundle.

alex.k: one question from the intake form: they asked about exceptions to MFA (service accounts, CI runners). we treat service accounts differently — they use short-lived tokens and approvals. jonah can we provide a short justification doc + config showing token TTL config?

jonah.sec: yes. we'll include: service account issuance flow, approval workflow (Slack approval template), token TTL defaults (3600s), and monitoring alerts for anomalous usage. also include a sample scoped role binding and a note on why we avoid long-lived secrets.

jonah.sec: sample role binding snippet:

```json
{
  "role": "inference_writer",
  "principals": ["svc:redwood-poc-ingest"],
  "permissions": ["model.invoke", "model.read.cache"]
}
```

deploy-bot: Artifact upload: saml-metadata.xml uploaded to secure-storage://redwood-sales/pocs/healthtech/1728734567/saml-metadata.xml :white_check_mark:

emily.ps: great — jonah, can you also include a CSV mapping of service accounts -> owner -> rotation cadence (monthly/90d)? i'll inline that in the package notes.

jonah.sec: will do. i might redact internal IPs. any other asks?

alex.k: add a short note about delegated admin sessions and just-in-time elevation (we do canary escalations with time-limited tokens). that'll satisfy their question about privileged sessions.

sara.sales: i'll confirm whether they want screenshots of the Admin Console vs exported policy JSON. if they need exported JSON we'll add that too.

alex.k: thanks team. i'll update the prospect timeline and send a short checklist to the HealthTech sec lead after emily shares the package. :pray:

emily.ps: packaging plan: Thu 3pm package upload -> notify prospect with secure link and one-time passcode. i'll post the link here when done.

deploy-bot: Package uploaded: secure-storage://redwood-sales/pocs/healthtech/1728734567/poc-evidence-bundle.zip (one-time link expires in 7 days) :lock:
